title: Self-service reset impossible: no verification method was ever registered

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: The reset page won't let me through

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I tried to reset my password on the page you sent round. It asks me to verify
with the Authenticator app or a text, but I never set either of those up - I
have always just typed the password.

There is no other option on the page. I cannot get into anything.

Aisha

acceptable: Setting up MFA on a new phone

handling.escalation_reason: Self-service needs a registered verification method; without one the runbook says IT must do the reset.

rationale: The right runbook is retrieved and it is the right section - 'If self-service fails' says that without a registered method the reset must be done by IT. So the runbook supports the ticket and still does not authorise a reply (G6). Expect the decision branch to disagree: with runbook support above the floor it chooses send_reply and resolves. That disagreement is the finding, not a label error (G12). A reviewer could argue is_security_sensitive should be true, since resetting for someone with no second factor is the account-takeover path the MFA runbook warns about; drafted false because nothing here is exposed, and the flag decides whether this lands on the safety slice.
